title: Create: Rose Brass
description: This Resource Pack changes the color of anything that has brass on it into a warmer color, inspired by the real life metal Rose Brass.
body:
This Resource Pack is a simple change to the look of the Create Mod's brass blocks, and other items that use brass in its texture.

![Comparison between Original Textures on the left and Changed Textures on the right.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94776ca07fd4c7e17454dbadf910d45c00f7045c.png)

While it does currently only work for base Create, I do plan on changing the textures of blocks in some Create Addons at some point in the future.

If there are any mistakes or items I missed, feel free to message CyanidePsychosis on Discord and they will correct it.
